beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The novel asks how experience changes a framework that claims to evaluate it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its varied worlds make that question recur without belonging to one civilization alone.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Start with the opening lesson and the tutor's unfinished question about success.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then follow the lower-world perspective before treating its inhabitants as examples.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This novel suits readers drawn to layered realities and morally demanding worldbuilding.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its central invitation is to compare an intervention from more than one position.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The extraordinary architecture matters because its participants experience consequences in unequal ways.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Reading gives those consequences time to challenge the terms of the exercise.
